name: Banana
description: One of the most popular fresh fruits in the world. Soft, sweet, and easy to digest, bananas are known for their potassium content and quick energy from natural carbohydrates.

faqs.q: Are bananas good for weight loss?
faqs.a: Bananas can fit into a weight loss plan. They are relatively low in calories for their volume and the fiber content helps with satiety. The main thing to watch is portion size, since the sugars add up if you eat several in a day.

faqs.q: When is a banana most nutritious?
faqs.a: Riper bananas have higher sugar content but also higher antioxidant levels. Less ripe bananas contain more resistant starch, which acts like fiber and feeds beneficial gut bacteria.
